sources.name: UniProt P19957
sources.use: Sequence identity, mature-peptide boundaries and disulfide annotation.
sources.boundary: Annotation is not a measurement of the team's expressed product.

sources.name: PDB 2REL
sources.use: Coordinate comparison and an experimental starting conformation for the MD pilot.
sources.boundary: NMR conformers are not time points; the pilot starts from one conformer.

sources.name: PDB 1FLE
sources.use: Reference interface and a bound-structure redocking benchmark.
sources.boundary: The enzyme is porcine pancreatic elastase, not human neutrophil elastase.

sources.name: PDB 2Z7F
sources.type: Human neutrophil elastase bound to SLPI
sources.use: Only enzyme chain E is extracted as the receptor for exploratory human NE–Elafin docking.
sources.boundary: The deposited inhibitor is SLPI, not Elafin. The original complex and legacy trajectory are not evidence for an Elafin complex.

sources.name: GTEx v8 · PI3
sources.use: Baseline tissue context from the archived gene-expression snapshot.
sources.boundary: Tissue medians do not establish IBD-specific effects or protein activity.

sources.name: IBDMDB / HMP2
sources.use: Candidate external context for temporal community variation and host–microbiome associations.
sources.boundary: Repeated samples require subject-aware analysis. Relative abundance alone cannot identify absolute growth or interaction rates.

sources.name: GEO GSE75214
sources.use: Candidate independent PI3 expression comparison, stratified by tissue and disease activity.
sources.boundary: RMA log2 values need platform annotation; colon and ileum must not be pooled as a disease contrast.

sources.name: Pan-GI cell atlas
sources.use: Candidate cell-type context to distinguish altered expression from altered cell composition.
sources.boundary: Donors, not individual cells, are the independent biological units.

sources.name: GEO GSE306374
sources.use: Candidate spatial context for PI3-expressing epithelial compartments.
sources.boundary: Spatial bins and transcripts do not directly measure active extracellular Elafin.

recentPapers.authors: Muto, T., Ito, G., Katsuda, H. et al.
recentPapers.title: IL-22 induces Paneth cell metaplasia in the colonic epithelium of ulcerative colitis, promoting wound healing via REG3A
recentPapers.relevance: PI3 is reported among transcripts in colonic metaplastic Paneth-cell clusters. This supports cell-resolved context, not a blanket Elafin-deficiency claim.

recentPapers.authors: Stojkovic, B., Bekkers, M., Violi, J. P. et al.
recentPapers.title: A microbiome meta-transcriptomics pipeline identifies a neutrophil elastase inhibitor that protects the colonic epithelial barrier
recentPapers.relevance: A recent example of linking cohort analysis to protein-function and barrier assays. The studied protein is BMG-1, not this project's Elafin; its results are not transferred to our construct.
